# Exp 4b costs (generated by scripts/make_costs_md.py)

Ledger total (Exp 4b, Together, actual): **$5.184** over 438 calls. Prices for repricing checked Nov 17, 2026 (PT):
- gpt-6-astra (OpenAI): $10 input, $1 cached input, $50 output per 1M tokens; prompts over 272K input tokens cost 2x input/cache and 1.5x output for the whole request. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-astra and https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing
- "Fable" = Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic, released Nov 9, 2026, its current top model): $8 input, $0.20 cache hit, $40 output per 1M tokens, no long-context surcharge. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing

Repricing is **same tokens, their price**: our open model's token counts multiplied by the closed model's list price. A different model would read and write a different number of tokens (and Anthropic's newer tokenizer counts about 30% more tokens for the same text), so this is not an estimate of what Astra or Fable would really cost. Output includes reasoning tokens. "Cached" uses each provider's cache-hit price for tokens Together reported as cached and ignores cache-write premiums (a lower bound); "no cache" prices every input token at the full rate.

## 2. Full repeat batch

All ledger calls tagged repeat_*: **$1.414** (273 calls), including $0.138 on runs that were killed and do not count as attempts (orphans repeat_flash_02/03/09/10 and the first repeat_seq_08 try cut off by the box restart). Same tokens at Astra prices: $61.138 cached / $102.138 no cache; at Fable prices: $46.177 / $81.711.

Cost per successful edit, repeat batch = total repeat spend / successes = $1.414 / 4 = **$0.353** (Astra same tokens $15.285-$25.535; Fable $11.544-$20.428).

Leakage-check runs (permuted network, 3 attempts): $0.287; Astra same tokens $12.592 / $22.278; Fable $9.428 / $17.823.

## 4. Total project cost

**$11.67** (Exp 1 $0.29 + 1b $1.64 + 1c $2.68 + 2 $0.52 + 4 $1.35 + 4b $5.184). Exp 1, 1b, 2 and 4 use the Notion Cost figures because their ledgers are not on this box. The Exp 4b part stays under the $10 budget set on Nov 16.

## Limits
- Repricing assumes the closed model would use the same tokens. It would not: it might need fewer turns or more reasoning. Treat it as a price comparison per token, not a forecast.
- Cache treatment differs by provider; the cached column is a lower bound because cache writes are not charged.
- 7 Exp 4b calls ($0.195; timed-out or cut-off streams with no usage report) are charged at a conservative estimate in our ledger.
- Batch/flex discounts (50% at both providers) are not applied.
